title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East  (Late Show) on 1970-05-15
source: source: aud cassette master; taped by Jimmy Cooper; 2 hitachi mics > hitachi trq-222; nakamichi dragon > benchmark adc1 24/96 > mac > adobe audition cc > fission > 16/44.1 xACT flac; power by furman p-2400IT; transfer & mastering - Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: Vivid audience recording captures a heartfelt St. Stephen and Uncle John’s Band, though Dark Star suffers from clipping.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers an intimate vibe with the crowd’s laughter and cheers audible during St. Stephen and Uncle John’s Band, and listeners love Jerry’s backing vocals and rare pedal‑steel touches. The performance is praised overall, but the Dark Star segment is marred by a noticeable recording clip that cuts the flow.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 5‑star review highlights an excellent performance and engaging audience ambience, offset only by clipping on Dark Star, leading to a high but slightly moderated rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crowd is clearly audible adding atmosphere; occasional clipping during Dark Star reduces clarity, but overall the tape remains listenable and lively.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set feels intimate with the audience’s reactions woven into the music, creating a jovial atmosphere; however the Dark Star segment is disrupted by a recording glitch.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for backing vocals and his pedal‑steel playing.
